components.text:
Circle: medium circle, ritual chalk.

Wakes the werewolf gene in the one on the centre: a human becomes a born werewolf, a vampire a bound hybrid and an Original a bound Original hybrid.

Refused for hunters, for people who already are werewolves and for heretics.

A vampire or Original made a hybrid this way is bound: it cannot shift until the Rite of the Moon. A refusal gives the ingredients back.

Moonstone: craft it from an amethyst shard and a silver ingot, in any order.

Needs the Werewolves mod.
